request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on objects, screens, clothing, signs and license plates, except the numerals or printed words the prompt explicitly asks for. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

A close-up photograph of a simple white tear-off desk calendar pad on a small dark stand, sitting on a light oak desk and facing the camera squarely, perfectly centered. The front page shows exactly one printed word, MONDAY, in large bold black sans-serif capital letters across the middle of the page, perfectly spelled; the word spans about 75 percent of the page width, and the page is about 50 percent of the photo width and about 60 percent of the photo height. The page has no numbers, dates, month names, other words, lines, grids or logos. Soft natural morning daylight from a window on the left; a small green potted plant and a plain white mug stand softly out of focus near the far left and right edges. No hands and no people.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
